_comment: Kiro agent hooks. These fire on workspace events and run in the background, so quality gates are enforced by the environment rather than by remembering. Ported from the local .git/hooks/pre-commit, but stronger: hooks fire on save and on spec task completion, not only at commit time.

hooks.name: lint-and-test-on-save
hooks.description: Run ruff and pytest whenever a Python source file is saved.

action.command: ruff check --fix . && ruff check . && python -m pytest -q

hooks.name: contract-change-guard
hooks.description: The frontend contract is a published interface. Any edit must re-validate every sample payload and flag the change for the team.

action.prompt: src/schemas/contract.py changed. Run `python validate.py`. If any sample fails, report exactly which field changed and whether it is a breaking change under the versioning rules in CONTRACT-v1.md. If it is breaking, state that CONTRACT_VERSION must be bumped and the frontend team notified. Do not modify the samples to make them pass.

hooks.name: grounding-invariant-guard
hooks.description: The grounding guarantee is structural. Changes to the nodes that carry it must be checked against the invariant, not just against the tests.

action.prompt: A graph node or the topology changed. Verify three invariants still hold: (1) no edge reaches a generate_* node without passing through retrieve_prices; (2) Citations are created only in retrieve_prices; (3) PlanDraft still has no price, cost, or total field. Report any violation as a blocking defect. Then run `python -m pytest -q`.

hooks.name: prompt-change-requires-eval
hooks.description: A prompt edit with no eval run is an unmeasured change. This is the gate that stops prompt engineering from becoming guesswork.

hooks.name: security-review-on-iam
hooks.description: Least privilege is opt-in. Every IAM change gets read before it lands. infra/manual/*.json is gitignored, so it never reaches a PR diff — this hook is the only review it gets, which makes the pattern more load-bearing than the others, not less.

action.prompt: An infrastructure or IAM file changed. Check against .kiro/steering/security.md: no wildcard in Action or Resource; DynamoDB permissions scoped to specific table ARNs; no secrets in plaintext; DynamoDB PITR enabled; API Gateway throttling configured. Report each violation with the file and line.

hooks.name: new-node-needs-tests
hooks.description: Tests gate implementation rather than trailing it.

action.prompt: A new graph node was created. Before it is wired into build.py, write tests in tests/ covering: the happy path, the failure path, and the node's behaviour when its model call raises ModelError. Follow the existing style in tests/test_intent.py. Do not modify build.py until the tests exist and pass.

hooks.name: model-config-change-guard
hooks.description: Enabling a model is a routing change with cost and quality consequences.

action.prompt: config/models.json changed. Report which tasks now route differently by running the registry's explain_routing(). If a model was newly enabled, state that it has not been scored on the golden set and that `python evals/run_intent.py --compare` should be run before it serves production traffic. Verify every enabled model has a capabilities block, since code paths branch on tool_use and prompt_caching.

hooks.name: fixture-regeneration
hooks.description: Keep the committed seed data in sync with its generator.
